name: Kyuusei Tenshi Seraphimeiah -In'yoku no Yami ni Shizumu Heroine-
original_name: 救聖天使セラフィーメイア -淫欲の闇に沈むヒロイン-
source:
Seraphimeiah, righteous angel of the heavens, has been selected to defend Earth from Verial, soldier of Pandemonium, an evil organization hell-bent on invading the human world. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077258.html]DLSite English[/url]]
